name: androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
description: AndroidX Activity provides a basic screen used by Compose testing; Duckie QuackQuack UI/core and YTag also include this same Activity entry. It has no home-screen launch entry and only opens when app or test code starts it directly.
disableEffect: Compose tests or code that explicitly opens this basic screen cannot use it; ordinary app screens and QuackQuack or YTag controls remain available.
